additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419704-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/01] RFID Card Not Working CRM:02699000012
additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien Bonhomme,
Hope you are doing well.
As I analyzed the logs, I observed that the RFID Tagid 058033831B7300 was scanned at 06:41 for initializing the charging session.
2025-04-07T06:41:41.907093+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/9fb0da48033a[734]: OCPP: Send command: Authorize (b103be3b-3d4a-4784-9901-401b2a77c4bc) - {"idTag":"058033831B7300"}
At 06:43, the charger received a command from the backend to stop the transaction. The logs indicate that the command was executed successfully, and the transaction was stopped at that time.
2025-04-07T06:43:06.443149+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/9fb0da48033a[734]: OCPP: Send command: StopTransaction (a3caa25f-b437-44b1-8301-85a8054c7fc5) - {"meterStop":76111057,"timestamp":"2025-04-07T06:43:06.435Z","transactionData":[{"timestamp":"2025-04-07T06:43:06.435Z","sampledValue":[{"value":"37","location":"EV","unit":"Percent","measurand":"SoC"},{"value":"0","location":"Outlet","unit":"Wh","context":"Transaction.End","measurand":"Energy.Active.Import.Interval"}]}],"transactionId":46049543}
Additionally, at 06:54, there was another attempt to stop the charging session using the same RFID Tagid 058033831B7300, which was also logged.
2025-04-07T06:54:23.435174+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/9fb0da48033a[734]: OCPP: Send command: Authorize (641a8ad4-18c8-47f3-bbd5-daf5c2274d71) - {"idTag":"058033831B7300"}
2025-04-07T06:54:24.756942+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/9fb0da48033a[734]: OCPP: Received result: Authorize (641a8ad4-18c8-47f3-bbd5-daf5c2274d71) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Accepted","expiryDate":"2025-04-14T06:54:00Z","parentIdTag":""
If you continue to experience issues, please let us know as we are currently updating the charger to the latest firmware version6.1.3, and then we can further analyze the issue.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
